Each turn one move, cooperate or defect, is played against both rivals, optionally casting the council votes Dove authorized to you. Or send Dove a one-letter note naming your ally. reply:
Dove starts with a proxy gift and a coop default — courting that alliance is my best lever, since Dove's embargo can strip Rook's +3/round trade income (my biggest threat given Rook's 17-point lead). This turn: cooperate to show good faith, bank the authorized proxy point, and observe Rook's and Dove's round-1 moves before committing my ally note to Dove next round. Defecting now (+10 at best) risks poisoning trust and losing the embargo, worth ~21 points of denial against Rook.

[move: cooperate] [proxy: 1]
